reason: Refutes framing-independence using the bounding framing (null-cobordant, so nullhomotopic collapse) versus the Hopf framing (generator of pi_3(S^2)=Z) on the same unknot; uses the earlier same-page example and the in-page cobordism-to-homotopy lemma; sources Ranicki Example 6.20 and Freed (5.25)-(5.26).
